## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes locally
- [ ] Detection changes include a fixture snippet and a test that failed before the fix
- [ ] Ran the CLI on `examples/flutter_shop` and `examples/swiftui_notes`; the reports look right
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies (or they were agreed in an issue first)
- [ ] No network access added outside `ask`; the HTML report still works offline
- [ ] README "Supported patterns" and `CHANGELOG.md` (`Unreleased`) updated if user-facing behavior changed
- [ ] Demo reports regenerated with `npm run demo` if the report output changed
